---
title: "Before the session"
---

Before the session, read the background page and open the deck once on the machine that you will bring. There is nothing to install and nothing to register for.

## 1. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the claim on which the session works and the five reanalyses of it in the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026).

## 2. The deck

[Open the deck](../../live/short.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Open the deck the evening before the session, on the machine and in the browser that you will bring, wait until the cell on its second slide shows a "Run Code" button, and run it. It should report 270 rows, 27 countries and 10 years, and your browser then keeps the files that the deck downloaded. If the deck does not load, try another browser; the browser lab holds the same tasks outside the deck, as the fallback.
